transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we finalize the receiving sequence for tomorrow's dock schedule, I need to confirm the handling requirements for all three shipments. I know Charlie vehicle parts are standard with no special handling needs. But I need to understand if Alpha generator filters or Bravo clinic consumables have any special handling requirements or carrier appointment constraints that would affect how we sequence them. Who can speak to those?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical constraint for Alpha. The appointment confirmation is in the transportation inbox but has not yet been added to the dispatch brief.
